title: Description of the Osiris Shaft

tellings.quote: So, the Osiris shaft is a three-level structure located on the eastern causeway leading from the central pyramid down to the valley temple and the sphinx. And it's 33-m underground triple chamber system.

plain: A researcher named Jeffrey Drum describes the Osiris Shaft, an ancient underground structure on the Giza Plateau in Egypt, on podcast host Jesse Michels' show. He says it sits along the raised walkway running from the central pyramid down to the valley temple and the Sphinx, and that it is a three-level system of chambers reaching 33 meters underground. He tells it as part of a case that something important lies beneath the pyramids.
